attchmntText: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of funds raised through preferential issues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirmed no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from a preferential issue of Rs. 324.00 million raised on March 1, 2024. All funds were utilized as per original objects. Regarding a second preferential issue of Rs. 303.50 million raised on January 12, 2024, the company reported a change in the objects of the issue. This change was approved by shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on September 25, 2025. The statement notes that despite the modification of objects, there is no deviation in the actual utilization of funds. The total amount raised across these preferential issues is Rs. 627.50 million.

attchmntText: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about disclosure under Regulation 30-Updates
voiceSummary: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited disclosed that UC Inclusive Credit Private Limited filed Commercial Arbitration Application No. 489 of 2026 before the Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge in Bengaluru. The application relates to an alleged corporate guarantee dated 31 January 2024 for a term loan of Rs. 5,00,00,000 extended to Agarwal Bulkactives Private Limited. The Company denies executing or authorizing this guarantee, citing unauthorized transactions by former management. The Civil Court issued an ex-parte ad-interim order on 6 November 2026, directing GBL and ABPL to show cause by December 4, 2026, why they should not furnish security of Rs. 8,27,15,948. A conditional order of attachment was also placed on certain properties. The Company plans to appeal the order. The validity of the guarantee is sub judice in prior litigation, and the NCLT previously dismissed UC Credit’s insolvency petition on 15 July 2026. No financial implications or claims are currently expected.

attchmntText: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited approved its standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors considered these results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The financial statements include a limited review report issued by Samria Kabra and Associates, Chartered Accountants. The Board Meeting commenced at 2:50 pm and concluded at 3:25 pm. The company filed this outcome with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited in accordance with SEBI regulations.
